title: Loop Corrections in Random Feature Models: Training Error and Generalization Gap
abstract: arXiv:2604.12827v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study fixed-design random feature ridge regression beyond the mean-kernel approximation. The expectation is taken over the frozen-feature ensemble, conditional on the training sample. Because the predictor is a nonlinear function of the empirical kernel, its mean training error, test error, and conditional generalization gap depend on centered kernel covariances as well as on mean kernel objects. We derive the covariance-level, or one-loop, corrections from a finite resolvent identity. This avoids an almost-sure Neumann-series assumption and yields an explicit remainder bound for the training error. The test correction additionally requires mixed train--test covariance tensors and therefore cannot, in general, be recovered from the train-restricted kernel law alone. translated_title: 随机特征模型中的循环修正：训练误差与泛化差距
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.12827v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们研究了超越均值核近似的固定设计随机特征岭回归。期望是在冻结特征系综下，以训练样本为条件进行的。由于预测器是经验核的非线性函数，其平均训练误差、测试误差和条件泛化差距不仅依赖于均值核对象，还依赖于中心化核协方差。我们从有限预解恒等式推导出协方差级或单循环修正。这避免了几乎必然的诺伊曼级数假设，并为训练误差提供了显式的余项界。测试修正额外需要训练-测试混合协方差张量，因此通常无法仅从训练受限的核律中恢复。数值实验表明，在受控正则化机制下，协方差项消除了主导的逆宽度偏差，而消融实验则表明（截断部分未完整呈现）。
tldr: 本文推导了随机特征模型中协方差级循环修正，证明其能消除训练误差的主导逆宽度偏差，但测试误差修正需额外的混合协方差信息。
en_tdlr: This paper derives covariance-level loop corrections in random feature models, showing they remove the leading inverse-width bias in training error, while test corrections require additional mixed covariance information.
